description:
The Mumbai Heritage Walk is a great way to experience the city’s vibrant culture and rich history.
Mumbai Heritage Walk is probably known as the ‘dream city’ and rightly so the city is indeed like a beautiful, magnificent dream. Old Mumbai is the part of Mumbai that represents its heritage and history. Reflecting on the time of Colonial era, the area is studded with numerous tourist attractions. From Chhatrapati Shivaji terminus to the ‘White town’ to the University library to the magnificent Marine drive, the city has so many spectacular attractions that one can never miss. Explore all these places of Old Mumbai and many more with this heritage walk tour.

Walking tours expose many residents and visitors to the structures.

featured_reviews.review_text:
we did the essential Mumbai tour with Parvez. he was a great guide for a great trip. The tour started off near the Asiatic society, and we walked around the area originally inside the Fort walls. He helped create a wonderful imagery of what the city looked like when it was founded along with some stories about the history before hand that led up to establishing Mumbai.
The trip was a mixture of walking and getting in and out of a car to see various sites around the city. It was quite varied and allowed us to see some unusual sites we would not have seen by ourselves.
at the end of the tour, we stopped at a restaurant with Parvez and tried several dishes that were excellent. Common food that is regularly served in restaurants, but this was delicious.

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Joisher
featured_reviews.review_text:
A study on Rajawadi Garden
PUBLIC PARK: RAJAWADI GARDEN (Ghatkopar East, Mumbai)

1. ACCESSIBILITY
* Park is surrounded by local road (6 m wide) on all 4 sides .
* The park is on the same level as the road so no steps/ ramp is required
* There are 2 entry gates on 2 opposite sides, each 4 m wide.
* No area is specifically designated for parking.
2. ACTIVITIES IN THE PARK
* Jogging track, children's play area, gravel walking track for accupressure, seating arrangement.
* Other facilities: Drinking water, public toilet.
* Activities Outside the Park: Pani Puri vendor,     small Ferris wheel, merry-go-round , horse carriage.
3. AGE OF PEOPLE VISITING DURING DIFFERENT TIMES OF THE DAY
Since the park is in a residential area, it is mostly visited by senior citizens, children, families etc ( the people living nearby).

4. SAFETY
*Visibility: the park is surrounded by local road on all 4 sides. The park is bounded by cast iron railing hence the activities going on in the park are visible from outside. It ensures informal surveillance preventing crime.
* Lighting: there is poor lighting in the park. Street lamps have been provided in the open spaces and lawns but no lighting is provided along the pathway. The visibility after sunset is clear enough to make out the pathways but the nooks and corners of the park remain dark.
* Presence of undesirables: the current society finds couples showing affection to each other in public spaces as undesirable. This is often seen in public parks and in this park too.

Ghatkopar Railway Station is one of the most important and well-connected stations in Mumbai. It plays a crucial role in daily commuting, especially for office-goers and students. There are plenty of food stalls, shops, autos, taxis, and bus connectivity available just outside the station, making last-mile travel easy. Ghatkopar Station truly reflects the fast-paced spirit of Mumbai and serves as a reliable transit hub for lakhs of commuters every day.

Excellant place for Morning Walker, kids and families.

HERITAGE GARDEN: De-stressing and Rejuvenating in a Different World

Pramod Chavan

Surrounded by high-rise concrete buildings and glass-fronted skyscrapers opposite the Glen Towers on Cliff Avenue Road in Powai, a Heritage Garden means Bharat Ratna Atal Bihari Vajpayee Udyan is a de-stressing and rejuvenating world.

The special thing about this ten-acre park is that it is not just a park for one class or one age group. On one side are college students on the fence and on the other a group of senior citizens reminiscing. Here, among the youth the guitar tunes, and among the senior citizens, someone easily makes the flute tunes, mesmerizing the entire atmosphere.

Apart from the magnificence of the surrounding residential complexes, it is the right space for yoga enthusiasts with its many offices and commercial setups. It has become a place for those who practice regular and mixed martial arts.

The landscaped lawns, a separate play area for children, a Japanese-style Miyawaki patch on one side and a circular walking path that winds around the periphery of the park make the Heritage Garden a pleasant place to spend an evening with your loved ones.

Heritage Garden is one of the main places for morning walkers in Powai and the surrounding area. There is a beautiful gazebo apart from benches at regular intervals. It also has a beautiful artificial pond which often has beautiful lotus flowers.

The stone structure along the circular walkway attracts the attention of all new visitors. There is also a restroom on one side of the park.

Another special feature of this park is that some other parks in the city often organize events, so people coming to the park have a lot of trouble. However, events or other mass activities are still not allowed here without permission.

The man-made wells located at the corners of the park are used the most during monsoons. But it has not been able to escape from the habit of people coming to the garden to throw large amounts of waste.

Garden gates open at 5 am, after that they are closed from 12 noon to 4.30 pm... and open again from 4.30 pm to 10 pm.

Forest Park in Powai is an escape from the pollution and the hustle of the city. Here’s why you should take some time off.

Amidst the sky scrapers at Hiranandani is a green patch that Powai residents look forward to. Since the rain Gods have been more than gracious off late, we think it would be a treat to sit and admire the weather and smell the rain hitting the mud.

The park sits quietly at Hiranandani Gardens and is frequented by fitness enthusiasts, strollers and college students. It’s open from 6AM in the morning till 10AM and reopens again till 6 PM. The entry to the park is free.
